Shared FMA Heavy is the highest-utilized pipeline (90.0%) based on elapsed cycles in the workload, taking into account the rates of its different instructions. It is a physical pipe and shared by the logical pipes FMA Heavy and ALU Lite. The pipeline is over-utilized and likely a performance bottleneck.
